name: Tabou
source:
A young boy from the town of Manjusara who saves [url=/c47272]Ion[/url]. Childhood friends with [url=/c60284]Casty[/url], he always rushes into danger to help his friends and cheers them up however he can. Headstrong but a bit thickheaded. Ta-bou is a nickname from the last syllable of his real name, Delta. 'De-ru-ta', 'ta-bou', 'bou' being a nickname for young boys like him.

[From [url=https://pastebin.com/egW4rhTK]Ciel Nosurge Summary[/url]]
